contentText: Delano D'Souza is pleased to welcome Larry Sabato, Director of the University of Virginia Center for Politics. Mr. Sabato dissects Trump’s combative unpredictable foreign policy and strained transatlantic relationships. With the US president in Davos, Mr. Sabato offers insight into a presidency defined by chaos, retribution, and revenge. Amid European miscalculations, domestic disillusionment, and the transactional core of Trump’s geopolitical ambitions, Mr. Sabato paints a portrait of a world struggling to work with a leader who does not adhere to norms or diplomacy.
